title: Wild Weather
intro: Look at the sky! What is the weather like?

words.sentence: The temperature today is thirty degrees.
words.def: This tells you how hot or cold it is.

parentTip.vi: Xem dự báo thời tiết cùng con: "What's the temperature today? Is there going to be a storm?"

chat.yes: That's okay! Let's count after the lightning.

gaps.s: I can't see the hills. There's a lot of ___.
First you see the ___, then you hear the thunder.

text.title: The Big Storm
lines: Last night there was a big storm.
The wind was very strong, and it rained all night.
I saw lightning over the hills and heard loud thunder.
In the morning, there was fog, and we could not see the bridge.

questions.q: Why couldn't they see the bridge?
